statement: For rank-exactly-three A with sigma_min of its three nonzero eigenvalues at least one in magnitude, if the spectral-frame rows occupy at most m projective directions then ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= 2(2*pi+3*sqrt(3))*binom(m,3). In particular m<=4 gives a bound <92.
proof_mechanism: Aggregate each direction class into an independent scalar bank with density cap sqrt(2); use Parseval+Cauchy-Binet to choose an aggregate triple with determinant-square at least 1/binom(m,3); convert this to a least-singular-value bound for its quadratic block; condition other aggregate banks and apply the source-pinned three-variable affine quadratic theorem.
partner_application: Using account03/B13 rational strict-slack witness completeness at C=92, every strict rational 92-counterexample must have rank>3 or rank3 with at least five projective row directions.
